title: Posting and Application of Payments on a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease
content:
**Servicing policy — posting lease payments, Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**

**When a payment can post.** A lease payment can be posted only while the lease status is active, maturity extended, repossessed, returned or early terminated. The status shown on the lease record decides.

| Lease status | Payment may post |
|---|---|
| Active | yes |
| Maturity extended | yes |
| Repossessed | yes |
| Returned | yes |
| Early terminated | yes |
| Pending funding, purchased, closed or charged off | no |

**Posting date.** A payment received before the cutoff time of 20:00 Central Time on a business day posts that day; otherwise it posts the next business day. A payment received at 19:59 Central Time on a business day posts that day; one received at 20:00 or later, or on a day that is not a business day, posts the next business day.

**Application of a monthly payment.** A monthly payment is applied in this order: monthly use tax, then the month's rent charge, then the month's depreciation, which reduces the adjusted lease balance, then term fees due. The month's rent charge applied is the adjusted capitalized cost plus the residual value, times the money factor, rounded to the cent; the month's depreciation applied is the adjusted capitalized cost less the residual value, divided by the term in months, rounded to the cent.

**End-of-term payments.** Payments toward end-of-term charges are booked against the end-of-term balance, never against the lease balance.

**Channel fees.** The channel fee for the payment channel is collected on top of the payment as a convenience fee. Purchase and reinstatement funds are accepted only as a cashier's check, a wire, a MoneyGram or a dealer remittance, and carry no channel fee.

**Hypothetical illustration of the application order**: a monthly payment of $532.11 on a lease whose month carries $30.12 of use tax, $113.10 of rent charge and $388.89 of depreciation, with no term fees due, is applied $30.12 to use tax, $113.10 to rent charge and $388.89 to depreciation, and the adjusted lease balance falls by $388.89.
